about_the_game:
Inspired by my first game 'Rise of the Penguins GB', 'Rise of the Penguins 2: Penguin's Dark Ascent' is a 2D Side-Scrolling Action-Platformer meant to feel like Rise of the Penguins GB but a more modern interpretation. Player's get to play as a penguin named Kaito who challenges the Crimson Star cult that is a group that was formed when the world went into Eternal Dusk and is preventing the red star from being reactivated causing unrest throughout the penguin community. Along the journey there are a few allies Kaito will meet that provide some dialogue for the player to interact with that is mostly optional. The story is meant to be brief and not hinder eager players that just want to play the game. Well at the same time giving a timeline to the events that occurred in the first game.

about ROP 2

  • estimated 6-8 levels in final version

  • each level has a mini boss and boss

  • variety of fun mechanics in each level

  • different enemies in each level

  • variety of strange penguin amalgamations and other deadly foes

  • satisfying blood as you kill enemies throughout the level

  • basic parry projectile mechanics

  • obtain items from Corvus and perks from Maven

  • consume mana to use items

  • apply a perk for a little buff

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Any modern Linux distribution with kernel version 4.15 or newer
  • Processor: Intel Core 2 Duo E8400 or equivalent
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: OpenGL 3.3-compatible GPU (e.g., NVIDIA GeForce 6200 or newer)
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 300 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Any standard sound card
